contentBlocks.text: Disability Grant Eligibility and Medical Vetting Guide
Individuals who cannot work due to a physical or mental condition can qualify for SASSA's Disability Grant. Vetting requires official medical clearance.

The Disability Grant exists to support South Africans who cannot work due to physical or mental conditions. It provides financial stability for those whose disabilities prevent employment for more than 6 months.

checklist: Must possess a medical report completed by a SASSA-commissioned medical officer
Must have a disability that prevents employment for longer than 6 months
restrictions: Your grant can be temporarily reviewed if your health condition improves

recommendedGrants.name: Grant-in-Aid (if you require a full-time caregiver)

steps.title: Book medical evaluation
steps.description: Book a medical evaluation at your local clinic or through the SASSA portal.

steps.title: Get evaluated
steps.description: Get evaluated by the designated SASSA medical officer.

steps.title: Complete your application
steps.description: Take the signed medical report and ID to the SASSA office to complete your application.

faqs.question: Can I receive a disability grant if I get a private pension?
faqs.answer: Only if the private pension income falls below the strict means test threshold of R96,240 per year.

faqs.question: Can I get a temporary disability grant?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your disability is expected to last between 6 and 12 months, you may qualify for a temporary disability grant. A medical reassessment is required at the end of the period.
